extra.claim: Overtraining with fresh data reduces contamination effects, while supervised fine-tuning effects depend on pretraining contamination level.
extra.quote: Overtraining with fresh data reduces the effects of contamination, whereas supervised finetuning on the training set can either increase or decrease performance on test data, depending on the amount of pretraining contamination.

extra.claim: N-Day-Bench pulls fresh vulnerability cases monthly from GitHub advisories, using pre-patch code to test models in a sandboxed shell.
extra.quote: Each month it pulls fresh cases from GitHub security advisories, checks out the repo at the last commit before the patch, and gives models a sandboxed bash shell to explore the codebase.

extra.claim: Monthly refresh of test cases keeps the test set ahead of contamination or makes the contamination window honest.
extra.quote: The monthly refresh keeps the test set ahead of contamination — or at least makes the contamination window honest.

extra.claim: AGI Gauntlet uses obfuscated non-web prompt vectors to bypass dataset contamination and test reasoning beyond memorization.
extra.quote: Using obfuscated, non-web prompt vectors, it bypasses dataset contamination to stress-test true executive reasoning—pushing models past memorized training data to the precise point where their logic collapses.
